ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring tool designed for regional environmental bodies to automatically detect illegal industrial encroachment, unauthorized deforestation, and water body pollution using computer vision and geospatial time-series data.
ideas.title: EcoAudit Satellite: AI-Driven Industrial Land & Deforestation Compliance
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly aligns with Plaksha University's focus on practical social and environmental problems, matching winning patterns for clear measurable impact in environmental monitoring.

ideas.pitch: A voice-first, multilingual AI agent that interfaces via WhatsApp or phone calls to provide rural and semi-urban communities with localized preventive care guidance, vaccine tracking, and real-time symptom anomaly detection to flag local disease outbreaks early.
ideas.title: GraminSwasthya: Multilingual Rural Preventive Health & Outbreak Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets pressing public health challenges in developing regions, combining social impact with accessible voice technology that judges can instantly appreciate.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight computer vision system utilizing edge-optimized object detection to process video feeds from regular commuter trains, instantly spotting rail fractures, fastener missing points, and track obstructions to prevent derailments.
ideas.title: RailVision AI: Automated Railway Track & Infrastructure Defect Inspection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Involves genuinely hard engineering with robust computer vision models, demonstrating high technical feasibility and immediate utility for public safety infrastructure.

ideas.pitch: A local civic engagement app that intelligently matches isolated senior citizens with vetted nearby student volunteers for daily errands and social outings, optimizing route clusters and schedules for local non-profit transport.
ideas.title: Sahayak: AI-Powered Community Volunteer & Senior Outing Coordinator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a deeply felt community welfare problem with an empathetic, clear social ROI that appeals directly to judges looking for responsible AI applications.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven platform for local municipal bodies that ingests geo-tagged citizen grievance reports, categorizes infrastructure urgency using NLP, and provides a real-time resolution dashboard to track municipal accountability.
ideas.title: CivicPulse: Local Governance AI Copilot & Civic Issue Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines civic tech with actionable municipal transparency, delivering a concrete administrative benefit that aligns cleanly with the 'AI for Good' mandate.
